settings_schema.header:
## Mattermost Permissions

Governance plugin: non-admins request channel creation, Channel Admin promotion, Team Admin promotion, team creation, bot accounts, and incoming/outgoing webhooks — all via /mattermost-permissions or the sidebar UI. Requests route to the appropriate approval channel; System Admins (and optionally Team Admins) approve or deny with full two-way messaging.

### Approval channel routing

The plugin auto-creates these private channels in the approval team on first use:

| Request type | Auto-created channel |
|---|---|
| Channel creation, Channel Admin | Mattermost: Channel Requests (root or per-team) |
| Bot account creation | mattermost-bot-requests |
| Incoming / outgoing webhooks | mattermost-webhook-requests |
| Team creation | mattermost-team-requests |
| Audit log | mattermost-audit-requests |

All channels are seeded with System Admins automatically. Configure the root approval team and channel below, then set up channel domain prefixes.

settings.help_text: When enabled, the plugin auto-creates a dedicated approval channel in every team (named by the setting below). Channel and admin-promotion requests route to the requester's team channel instead of the global approval channel above. Team Admins are added to their team's channel at creation time. Enabling this setting immediately creates channels for all existing teams.
When enabled, Team Admins of the approval team can click Approve/Deny in addition to System Admins.

Structured editor: define allowed channel prefixes (team-, project-, etc.) with descriptions and suffix rules. Requesters pick from a dropdown; the resulting channel URL is prefix+suffix. Includes preset packs for common org shapes and a live preview.
Tab-complete picker: pick users whose channel requests bypass approval and create the channel immediately. Useful for delegated managers.
Mattermost User Group name (without @) to @-mention on every bot account request. Members of this group are notified alongside System Admins. Leave blank to notify System Admins only.
